spec.name: higmem_numok_patterns
spec.purpose: Two-level event-turn memory index with coarse-to-fine retrieval, CogniGraph-style three-layer index note, dual-tree temporal/semantic index note, and self-hosted affiliate program registry shape

summary: Patterns from ZeroLoss-Lab/HiGMem (MIT) and dfg-ar/numok (MIT), plus ideas only from EverM0re/LiCoMemory (no LICENSE file) and rutgerswiselab/H-mem (repo 404): a two-level event-turn memory index where turns group into event summaries and retrieval descends from summaries to turns only inside matching events, with deterministic keyword rewrite and overlap+recency evidence filtering; a CogniGraph-style three-layer index note (pack summaries, entity-relation triples, source chunks) with a unified rerank weighing topic, recency, and keyword overlap; a dual-tree temporal/semantic index note with a deterministic mode rule; and an affiliate registry shape (partner record, referral link record, commission ledger as data only, status lifecycle, partner groups with custom commission rules, payout scheduling as a date rule only). All restated in our own words, stdlib-only, no provider/network/API-key/server/MCP/GPU/model-weight/payment code.
